english.title: Superintendent registrar issue a forbidden marriage certificate
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a superintendent registrar, knowingly and wilfully issued a marriage schedule of **(..SPECIFY THE PARTIES TO THE MARRIAGE..), the issue of which had been forbidden under section thirty of the Marriage Act 1949 by **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person entitled to forbid the issue of a marriage schedule
english.legislation: Contrary to section 75(3)(c) of the Marriage Act 1949.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
superintendent registrar
knowingly and wilfully
issued a marriage schedule
the issue of which which was forbidden
under section 30 of the Marriage Act 1949
by any person entitled to forbid it

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: The term 'marriage schedule' replaced the term 'certificates' of a superintendent registrar from the 4th May 2021 by the Marriage Regulations 2021 (SI 2021/411). For offences which occur before this date, please see H15907.
